name: Vidalytics
description:
Vidalytics is video hosting and analytics for marketers and agencies running VSLs and conversion-focused video. This connector lets Claude securely access your Vidalytics account via OAuth so you can ask about performance without exporting CSVs or leaving chat.

Use it to find videos, pull play and conversion stats, analyze drop-off before CTAs, compare launches, check folders and setup, and review API quota. When you ask, Claude can also take guarded actions like publishing, duplicating, or applying settings templates. Tool calls use your existing Vidalytics Public API allowance - no separate MCP fee.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vidalytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vidalytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.vidalytics.com/public/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vidalytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vidalytics lists 33 MCP tools, including apply_settings_template, create_folder, create_video_cta, delete_video_thumbnail, duplicate_video, get_api_usage, get_video, get_video_by_embed_guid, get_video_ctas, get_video_dropoff, get_video_embed, and get_video_live_metrics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vidalytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Vidalytics in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Vidalytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vidalytics is developed by Vidalytics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
